_comment: Banks for the room key generator (app/room_keys.py). System-neutral on purpose: creatures are described, not statted, and treasure is described, not priced, so the GM can drop in whatever their game uses. Tiers: light / moderate / tough / boss.

fantasy: Water drips steadily from the ceiling and pools in the cracks of the floor.
Old torch brackets line the walls, most of them empty.
The air is cold and smells of damp stone.
Faded murals cover the walls, scratched out in places.
Rubble from a partial collapse is heaped against one wall.
Thick cobwebs hang from the ceiling like curtains.
The floor is worn smooth down the middle, the way a path is worn by many feet.
A low, uneven hum can be felt through the floor more than heard.
Scorch marks climb the walls and the ceiling is black with old smoke.
Dust lies undisturbed, except for one narrow set of tracks.
modern: A bare bulb hangs from a wire, swinging slightly.
The walls are water-stained and the paint is peeling in long strips.
Graffiti covers every reachable surface.
The place smells of mildew, old smoke and something worse underneath.
Pallets and broken furniture have been shoved against the walls.
A radio somewhere is playing static, very quietly.
The floor is gritty with broken plaster and glass.
Wires dangle out of the ceiling where the lighting was stripped.
Boarded-up windows let in thin stripes of light.
Cold air flows in from a vent that should have been sealed.
hightech: Status lights blink in a slow pattern along the wall panels.
A thin haze hangs in the air, lit from beneath by the floor strips.
The ventilation here has a faint, rhythmic knocking.
Cables snake across the deck, taped down in some places and not in others.
The lighting is dim and tinted red, as if on emergency power.
Sections of the wall panelling have been pried open and left hanging.
A low electrical whine rises and falls at irregular intervals.
Everything is spotless, which is somehow more unsettling than neglect.
Frost has formed around a leaking coolant line.
A dead display flickers briefly and shows a single line of corrupted text.

1d3 cultists in the middle of a muttered ritual

a basilisk coiled around a broken pedestal
1d4 suits of animated armour, one of them a little faster

a young dragon asleep on its hoard
an orc warlord and his bodyguard
a vampire lord entertaining his thralls

a lone security guard on a smoke break
a teenage urban explorer, hopelessly lost

two armed guards watching a bank of monitors
a pack of feral dogs defending a den

a hit squad waiting in ambush

a paranoid ex-soldier and his rigged room

a corrupt officer and his private security team
the monster at the heart of the whole mystery

light: 1d4 cleaning drones with badly broken priorities
a damaged service bot, harmless and very chatty
a lone scavenger, wary and lightly armed
a glitching maintenance cyborg who is willing to cooperate
moderate: an automated turret and its repair drone
a swarm of crawlers infested with nanites

an engineered predator that escaped from a lab

a corporate black-ops team leader and squad

an experimental weapons platform that has just come online
an engineered apex predator and its nest

fantasy: A pressure plate near the door fires darts from the walls.
A tripwire drops a portcullis behind anyone who enters, sealing the way back.
A rotted section of floor hides a spiked pit.
A blade swings across at head height when the far door is opened.
A poison needle is hidden in the lock of the nearest chest.
A warding glyph shrieks when stepped on, alerting the neighbouring rooms.
Part of the floor tilts and drops intruders into the dark below.
A lever on the wall looks helpful; pulling it fills the room with gas.
modern: A tripwire is rigged to a shotgun at knee height.
The floor has rotted through above a basement, hidden under a rug.
The door is booby-trapped with a fire bomb.
A car battery is wired to the door handle.
A hidden sensor sets off an alarm in the next room.
A cut gas line fills the room with fumes, and a spark would be a disaster.
A broken staircase hides a drop.
A snare yanks the first person to step wrong up by the ankle.
hightech: A laser tripwire grid covers the floor.
A mag-lock seals the room and floods it with gas.
A proximity mine is hidden under a floor panel.
The console delivers a heavy power surge to whoever touches it.
The deck plating is electrified when the door is closed.
A silent alarm calls security straight to this room.
The airlock begins to cycle open to vacuum.
A holographic decoy hides an active turret.

fantasy: Four statues, each pointing at a different exit. Only one is telling the truth.
A riddle is carved above a sealed door.
A pool of still water shows visions of the room's past.
A mechanism with coloured levers has to be set in the right order.
A rope bridge, badly frayed, crosses a chasm.
A mirror traps the reflection of anyone who looks at it for too long.
The door shuts behind the party and the water starts to rise.
A magical darkness snuffs out every torch.
modern: A combination lock. The code is on a scrap of paper somewhere else in the building.
A crowded storeroom of locked filing cabinets, only one of which matters.
A flooded room with a key somewhere on the bottom.
A safe with a keypad that has three worn digits.
A collapsed elevator shaft that has to be crossed.
Mould and fumes make the room unsafe without masks.
A security door that needs two keycards at once.
A room of mannequins that have all been moved since the last time anyone looked.
hightech: A terminal is asking for a credential that someone must find or bypass.
Gravity plates flip as soon as someone steps in.
A locked door that needs a code-breaking attempt before security notices.
A radiation leak makes the room hazardous without shielding.
A power relay puzzle with colour-coded conduits.
A zero-gravity chamber with the exit on the far side.
A laser maze guards the console at the far end.
A voice lock responds only to a recorded phrase found elsewhere.

fantasy: Nothing of use here. Dust, old bones and the signs of someone else's passing.
A cold fire pit; the ash is still faintly warm.
Empty shelves, and a smell of long-spoiled food.
A collapsed bed and a few rags. Someone lived here once.
A scatter of broken pottery, and nothing else.
modern: Empty, apart from a mattress and some takeaway boxes.
A few overturned chairs and an old calendar on the wall.
Stripped of anything worth taking, but the stripping was recent.
Boxes of paperwork, long past caring about.
Someone has drawn a map on the wall and then crossed it out.
hightech: Empty apart from a dead console and a few torn cables.
Everything useful has been stripped out of the racks.
A locker room, all the lockers open and empty.
A storage bay with a single overturned crate.
A bare room with a clean patch on the floor where something heavy was recently moved.

stairs.down: A stairway leads down to another level.
stairs.up: A stairway leads up to another level.
